name: Lavandove pole
source:
...A young girl wakes up in the morning in an abandoned mansion. Her older sister has disappeared somewhere...

Chloe, a disabled girl, and her older sister Camila have faced difficult life challenges. Nevertheless, Camila tries her best to help Chloe get back to a full life, overcoming all the obstacles in her way...

[From [url=https://kamilafox.itch.io/lavender-field-demo]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
…一个年轻的女孩早上在一座废弃的豪宅中醒来。她的姐姐失踪了……

残疾女孩克洛伊和她的姐姐卡米拉面临着艰难的生活挑战。尽管如此，卡米拉仍尽全力帮助克洛伊恢复充实的生活，克服路上的一切障碍……
